prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1084; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Katy, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was moving slowly through the turn when the impact threw my car sideways. I braced myself on the steering wheel, and the pain in my left wrist was immediate. I was taken to the hospital, where the wrist was confirmed to be fractured. I am the named driver on this policy and I have provided the details of the crash as clearly as I can. Since the accident I have remembered a few small details, such as the other driver's lane position, but the core account of what happened has not changed from what I first reported.
